H.acceptance: Exact grid counts/range only; no probability or capital claim.

FND/EQN.acceptance: Endpoint, derivative and inverse equality; source/order/dimension/nonmonotone controls reject; no new-law claim.

SCM.acceptance: Split, stale, fork, replay, downgrade, audience, revocation and membership controls reject; empirical coupling null.

AI-COST.action: Manifest v25 with padding-exclusion proofs over twelve real leaves.

QOS/QSVT.action: Compose thirteen inverse pairs and bind a dependency DAG for sequential/parallel depth bounds.
QOS/QSVT.acceptance: Exact reconstruction, DAG, proof, tree, order and resource mutations with explicit bounds pass; hardware evidence null.
